cards.headline: Power & IPPs leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags

cards.body: Leaders: RUN +9.58%, ENPH +5.22%, SEDG +4.19%, WFRD +3.63%, ARRY +2.15%. Laggards: EOSE -6.63%, PWR -3.62%, ETN -2.43%, GEV -1.99%.
